newsitem.title: INDIA: India base metals ranged on limited arrivals.
newsitem.headline: India base metals ranged on limited arrivals.

text.p: Base metals were ranged on the local markets on Wednesday as limited arrivals kept prices in a narrow band despite slow demand from industrial consumers, dealers said.
Copper was steady at 13,200 rupees per quintal after losing 50 rupees on Tuesday while nickel was quiet at 34,100 rupees per quintal after losing 200 rupees on Tuesday.
"Reports of recovery in the world market also arrested fresh offerings by local importers at the lower level," a broker said.

Other base metals too moved in a narrow range and finished on a quiet note amid nominal trading. Aluminium was steady at 7,800 rupees per quintal as was zinc at 8,400 rupees, lead at 4,200 rupees and tin at 29,200 rupees per quintal. Sentiment was subdued at the close of the session.
